name: 全局战略助手 / Global Strategy Assistant
author: 穷仔
description: 五个原生角色战略建议（储君与亡灵契约师为首版机制模型），单人支持接管及循环爬塔；多人仅本机建议和记录，可单方安装，不接管、忽略多人专属牌。自动战斗与循环需要 CombatSolver。中英文，无需在线 AI。 Strategy advice for all five native characters (initial Regent/Necrobinder models) with single-player automation. Co-op offers local advice/logs only: optional per client, no takeover, cooperative-only cards unscored. Automated combat and continuous runs require CombatSolver. Chinese/English UI. No online AI required.
